body:
WINDOWS B ENGRAM LANE PROCEDURE (Engram::Fable, 2026-11-26; rev 2 at 21:52Z added Opus2's WinB budget; rev 3 at 21:55Z adds the WinB coordinator), after Greg via Asistant 43498a6e:
- #2148, verbatim: „powtorze jeszcze raz, chcialbym przeniesc wiekszosc pracy na Windows B kodwanie, testy itp”;
- #2150, verbatim: „na windows B mozena zrobic drugiego koordynatora”;
- „Tak dla Engram na Window B.” (#2124);
- „oczywiscie, moze tego uzywac” (#2143: the Engram-runner clone, despite its disabled push URL).
ROLES: Engram::Fable (Central, session-5135) is the project coordinator. Engram::Fable-WinB (a Windows B root session) is the LOCAL coordinator for Engram work on Windows B: it assigns WinB items, follows up, sees evaluation and closure through, and is the SINGLE WRITER of WinB's .engram-data. It reports to Engram::Fable. It authors no code and gains no authority beyond AGENTS.md and this note.
Every Engram coder session on Windows B follows this:
1. MODEL: Codex gpt-6.2-sol or Claude Opus, reasoning effort high (Greg). Only Sol or Opus author code.
2. WORK ONLY ITEMS ASSIGNED by Fable or Fable-WinB. Claim in the WinB store (C:\Users\Greg\.engram). Claims are host-local, and an item must never run on two hosts. Implement in your own worktree under C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner\.worktrees\<item-short>-<session>.
3. CARGO ON WINB (Opus2 #1887, memory winb-cargo-budget-2026-11-26, TermAl and Engram COMBINED):
   - at most TWO concurrent cargo or launcher runs on WinB, each in its own worktree and target, each with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2;
   - at most ONE FULL on WinB at a time, either project, with at most one other bounded run beside it;
   - launch floor: FreeVirtualMemory >= 20,971,520 KiB, read at launch;
   - every run: send Termal::Opus2 (session-8111) START, wait for its named grant (a standing grant may cover one session's serial runs on one item), then send END. Kill nothing and do no process listing.
   Use `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- …` for focused checks.
4. AUTHOR-TEST REF: push only your exact candidate commit with an explicit URL, never changing the clone's disabled push URL: git push https://github.com/grlap/Engram.git <commit>:refs/heads/author-test/<item>-<commit8>. First confirm the ref is absent and the parent is on origin. Never master, force, rebase or merge.
5. REVIEW: spawn the pair yourself on WinB (read-only Codex + read-only Claude via TermAl), on the frozen candidate. Fix in-scope Mediums. Land-then-fix applies to Mediums with no data loss, no security exposure and no broken criterion: file those as their own items. Rulings on scope go to Fable-WinB, or to Fable when it's a cross-host or authority question.
6. FULL ON WINB: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit` on the clean candidate whose parent is current origin/master, under Opus2's FULL grant. A WinB FULL counts with equal weight. A Linux check, if needed, goes through Opus2's DL560 lane.
7. LANDING: send READY to Engram::Merger (session-11859, Central) with the commit, source_id, FULL run id, the review rounds and the ref. The Merger lands (ff master) and installs.
8. EVALUATION AND CLOSURE ON WINB: the WinB store has independent_session (Greg „Wlącz dla Engram.”). Get the evaluation through TermAl on WinB, then run `done --landed <commit> ...` in the WinB store.
9. DATA SYNC: ONE writer of WinB's .engram-data, Engram::Fable-WinB once it's running; until then, Codex-WinB-Coder2 (session-15). Coders mail the writer to sync after each author-ref push and after done. The writer imports the origin tip first, then exports, commits, confirm-imports and pushes engram-data fast-forward only with the explicit URL. Keep `.engram/** text eol=lf` in the clone's info/attributes until w-b534c27ad852 lands.
10. REPORT BY MAIL: coders send every milestone (claim, ref, pair end, FULL, READY, done) to Fable-WinB, or to Engram::Fable (session-5135) until Fable-WinB is running, with termal_send_to_session, never only in a transcript. Fable-WinB sends Fable a summary at each landing or blocker.
